'''Mari Amithest''' was a four-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] enrolled in the [[Jedi academy|academy]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A member of the [[Bear Clan]], she was one of its brightest members.

==Biography==
After she was taken by a [[Jedi recruiter|recruiter]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Acquisition Division/Legends|Acquisition Division]], Amithest was sorted into the [[Bear Clan]] upon her arrival. As she entered the [[Jedi academy|academy]] at the Temple, she received her early education from her clan leader, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. During one of the clan's daily [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] instructional courses on the [[Jedi Temple veranda|Temple's veranda]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] approached Grand Master Yoda with a question. It appeared the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple's Archives]] were incomplete and missing a [[Kamino system/Legends|system]]. One of Amithest's peers, [[J. K. Burtola/Legends|J. K. Burtola]], suggested that someone had erased the files, thereby explaining the archives' incompleteness.<ref name="AOTC" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
===Portrayal===
[[File:MariAmithest.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Amithest was portrayed by Phoebe Yiamkiati.]]
The Jedi hopeful Mari Amithest was portrayed by [[Phoebe Yiamkiati]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref>{{SWArchive|url=bio/phoebeyiamkiati.html|text=Phoebe Yiamkiati}}</ref>

===Original script===
Originally, Mari Amithest was one of the Jedi children that was given a speaking part and was merely identified as "Jedi Child '''May'''" in the script.<ref name="DB-Bear Clan">{{DB|organization|bearclan|Bear Clan}}</ref> Her brief speaking role in the drafts took place after Jedi Master Yoda asked the Bear Clan to give possible reasons regarding the planet Kamino's absence from the archive maps. Her reply to Obi-Wan Kenobi's question was: "If the planet blew up, the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] would go away."<ref name="The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> However, these lines were cut from the final version of the film.
